title: Passage 29
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: When Albert Einstein was 16 years old, he imagined himself riding alongside a beam of light.
sentences.cn: 阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦16岁时，曾想象自己与一束光并驾齐驱。

sentences.en: He used this picture in mind to help him when working out the theory of relativity.
sentences.cn: 他推导出“相对论”时，也借助了脑海中的这幅图像。

sentences.en: Daydreaming, called Thought Experiments by Einstein, can make you have wild imaginings.
sentences.cn: 爱因斯坦将白日梦称为“思维实验”，它可以让你产生天马行空的想象。

sentences.en: We can imagine different landscapes, like mountains and forests.
sentences.cn: 我们可以想象不同的风景，比如高山和森林。

sentences.en: It lets your mind walk slowly around things that aren't happening right now.
sentences.cn: 它能让你的思绪缓慢游走于当下并未发生的事情周围。

sentences.en: It means thinking ahead to a holiday or a birthday party.
sentences.cn: 这意味着你可以提前畅想一个假期或一场生日派对。

sentences.en: Disappearing into a daydream lets your mind escape when things are difficult.
sentences.cn: 当遇到困境时，沉浸在白日梦中可以让你的思绪得以逃离。

sentences.en: It helps you deal with worries and fears.
sentences.cn: 它能帮助你应对忧虑和恐惧。

sentences.en: For example, imagining how you're going to speak up in class is like practising the scene in your head,
sentences.cn: 例如，想象自己如何在课堂上大胆发言，就像是在脑海中排练这个场景一样，能让你觉得更加镇定。

sentences.en: which can make you feel calmer.
sentences.cn: 例如，想象自己如何在课堂上大胆发言，就像是在脑海中排练这个场景一样，能让你觉得更加镇定。

sentences.en: Imagining graduating encourages you to work harder towards your learning goals.
sentences.cn: 想象毕业的场景，也可以激励你更加努力地实现学习目标。

sentences.en: Reading literature also inspires our creativity in daydreaming.
sentences.cn: 阅读文学作品也能激发我们在白日梦中的创造力。

sentences.en: When we picture ourselves as a princess or a queen wearing a beautiful dress,
sentences.cn: 当我们把自己想象成一位身穿美丽裙子的公主或王后时，

sentences.en: we let our minds wander in a fairy tale that brings us courage.
sentences.cn: 我们让自己的思绪遨游在能给我们带来勇气的童话故事中。

sentences.en: Then we may pick up our pens to write our own paragraphs.
sentences.cn: 然后，我们可能就会拿起笔写下属于自己的段落。

sentences.en: However, try not to let your mind be absent when you need to focus in class or cross the road.
sentences.cn: 但是，当你需要集中精力上课或过马路时，尽量不要让思绪游离。

sentences.en: Instead, find a time when you don't have to focus on anything,
sentences.cn: 相反，找一段无须专注任何事的时间来做白日梦，比如散步或刷牙的时候。

sentences.en: like going for a walk or brushing your teeth.
sentences.cn: 相反，找一段无须专注任何事的时间来做白日梦，比如散步或刷牙的时候。

sentences.en: Research shows that people often come up with more solutions to problems after daydreaming because it is similar to staying at a hotel,
sentences.cn: 研究表明，人们在白日梦后往往能想出问题的更多解决方案，因为这就好比入住酒店，在那里我们可以休息片刻。

sentences.en: where we can take a break.
sentences.cn: 研究表明，人们在白日梦后往往能想出问题的更多解决方案，因为这就好比入住酒店，在那里我们可以休息片刻。

sentences.en: So next time you're stuck on homework, stop for a moment and see where your daydreams take you.
sentences.cn: 所以，下次当你被作业难住时，不妨停下来片刻，看看白日梦会把你带向何方。
